findings.body: arasClient.ts does not validate XML well-formedness: looksLikeXml accepts mismatched opening/closing tags, and extractKnownXmlFields can extract ResultCode=0 from that malformed response, allowing create classification to succeed. Replace heuristic validation with structural parsing and add a regression test before merge.
